Updated the marker offset. Changed `markerFineTuneYOffset` from `0` to `-20` in `MiataruMapMarker.swift`. This moves the marker down by 20 points, aligning it with the accuracy circle.

The offset is applied to the entire marker view (line 230), so both the circle and the pin triangle move down together. This should align the marker pin with the accuracy circle.

The change will take effect the next time the app is built and run. Since the marker uses image caching, you may need to clear the cache or restart the app to see the change immediately.
